findings.title: Boolean conversion of PublishReceipt is less explicit than direct attribute
findings.body: The change replaces the explicit `receipt.accepted` with `bool(receipt)`, which relies on the truthiness of `PublishReceipt`. While this may work, it reduces clarity by hiding the intent behind a generic boolean conversion. Prefer the explicit attribute access to make the code's purpose clearer.

summary.problem: The change to `was_accepted` reduces code clarity by using a generic boolean conversion instead of an explicit attribute.
summary.done_well: The function name and signature remain clear and consistent with the module's style.
